name: equivalent_mode_exclusive_mac
description: Two logical signed 4x4 MAC PEs selected by mode are equivalent to one operand-multiplexed shared multiplier, with signed 8-bit accumulation and output.
scheduling_contract: mode selects exactly one logical PE per transaction; simultaneous outputs are not required

interfaces.input: signed a0,b0,a1,b1 and signed 8-bit acc0,acc1 plus mode
interfaces.fixed_point: two's-complement signed 4-bit operands and signed 8-bit accumulator/output; modulo 2^8 wrap

mode_switch.preconditions: mode is stable for the transaction

stimulus.provenance: Yosys SAT exploration; synthetic contract stimulus

constraints.schedule: one logical MAC is active per transaction
